column3: The path was steep. What does steep mean?
Ben checked the sky before leaving. Why?
The candle blew out. What happened?
Mia packed, checked her ticket and left.
The river kept rising all day. What may happen?
Sam hid behind Mum. How felt?
What happens last? Mix, bake, cool.
The forest was silent. What does silent mean?
The children planted seeds and watered them.
The gate was locked. What couldn't they do?
Jack grabbed his towel and goggles. Where is he going?
